usage: CallVariants.py [-h] [--platform PLATFORM] [--tensor_fn TENSOR_FN]
                       --chkpnt_fn CHKPNT_FN [--call_fn CALL_FN] [--gvcf GVCF]
                       [--ref_fn REF_FN] [--ctgName CTGNAME]
                       [--ctgStart CTGSTART] [--ctgEnd CTGEND]
                       [--sampleName SAMPLENAME] [--qual QUAL]
                       [--samtools SAMTOOLS] [--cmd_fn CMD_FN]
                       [--temp_file_dir TEMP_FILE_DIR] [--haploid_precise]
                       [--haploid_sensitive]
                       [--enable_long_indel ENABLE_LONG_INDEL]
                       [--keep_iupac_bases KEEP_IUPAC_BASES]
                       [--enable_dwell_time] [--use_gpu USE_GPU]
                       [--predict_fn PREDICT_FN] [--input_probabilities]
                       [--output_probabilities]

Call variants using a trained model and tensors of candidate variants

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --platform PLATFORM   Sequencing platform of the input. Options:
                        'ont,hifi,ilmn', default: ont
  --tensor_fn TENSOR_FN
                        Tensor input filename, or stdin if not set
  --chkpnt_fn CHKPNT_FN
                        Input a trained model for variant calling, required
  --call_fn CALL_FN     VCF output filename, or stdout if not set
  --gvcf GVCF           Enable GVCF output, default: disabled
  --ref_fn REF_FN       Reference fasta file input, required if --gvcf is
                        enabled
  --ctgName CTGNAME     The name of the sequence to be processed
  --ctgStart CTGSTART   The 1-based starting position of the sequence to be
                        processed, optional, will process the whole --ctgName
                        if not set
  --ctgEnd CTGEND       The 1-based inclusive ending position of the sequence
                        to be processed, optional, will process the whole
                        --ctgName if not set
  --sampleName SAMPLENAME
                        Define the sample name to be shown in the VCF file,
                        optional
  --qual QUAL           If set, variants with >=$qual will be marked 'PASS',
                        or 'LowQual' otherwise, optional
  --samtools SAMTOOLS   Path to the 'samtools', samtools version >= 1.10 is
                        required, default: samtools
  --cmd_fn CMD_FN       If defined, added command line into VCF header
  --temp_file_dir TEMP_FILE_DIR
                        EXPERIMENTAL: The cache directory for storing
                        temporary non-variant information if --gvcf is
                        enabled, default: ./
  --haploid_precise     EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. Only 1/1 is
                        considered as a variant
  --haploid_sensitive   EXPERIMENTAL: Enable haploid calling mode. 0/1 and 1/1
                        are considered as a variant
  --enable_long_indel ENABLE_LONG_INDEL
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Enable long Indel variants(>50 bp)
                        calling
  --keep_iupac_bases KEEP_IUPAC_BASES
                        EXPERIMENTAL: Keep IUPAC (non ACGTN) reference and
                        alternate bases, default: convert all IUPAC bases to N
  --enable_dwell_time   EXPERIMENTAL: Enable dwell time feature, which changes
                        tensor shape by adding one dimension
  --use_gpu USE_GPU     DEBUG: Use GPU for calling. Speed up is mostly
                        insignficiant. Only use this for building your own
                        pipeline
  --predict_fn PREDICT_FN
                        DEBUG: Output network output probabilities for further
                        analysis
  --input_probabilities
                        DEBUG: Use network probability outputs as input and
                        generate variants from them
  --output_probabilities
                        DEBUG: Output the network probabilities of gt21,
                        genotype, indel_length_1 and indel_length_2
